answer_1.quote: Multi-document summarization (MDS) aims to formulate a summary that captures the essence and main points of multiple documents on a specific topic.

answer_2.quote: We benchmark FABRIC on the quantitative metrics -Rouge-1 (R1), Rouge-2 (R2) and Rouge-L (RL), to evaluate the lexical overlap, as well as on qualitative metrics -BARTScore to compute the semantic overlap, and FactCC, and SummaC for faithfulness assessment.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation to assess the qualitative aspects of the summaries generated by FABRIC. The evaluation focused on five parameters -Informativeness (Inf), Relevance (Rel), Coherence (Coh), Fluency (Flu), and Topic coherence (Topic).
